means.idiom-jp: (記録するなどして)〜を把握する；〜の跡をたどる
means.example-sentence: His mother told him to keep track of all the money he spent while he was traveling.
means.sentence-jp: 彼の母親は彼に旅行中に使ったすべてのお金を把握しておくように言った。

cloze.maskedText: His mother told him to ____ all the money he spent while he was traveling.

notes: 反対表現は lose track of ~「〜の跡を見失う[跡がわからなくなる]」。
